title: A Fascinating Exterior Tour of Sagrada Família
text:
I recently took a private walking tour of Barcelona focused entirely on the exterior of the Sagrada Familia with Emma, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of my trip. Most visitors head straight inside, but this tour showed me that the outside of the basilica is a masterpiece in its own right, a true "Bible in stone."
